content: प्रदोष {%a.%} Bad, corrupt. .{@-षः@} .²1 .³({%a%}) A fault, defect, sin, offence, .³({%b%}) Transgression, violation. .²2 Disordered condition, such as mutiny, rebellion. .²3 Evening, nightfall, the first part of the night; प्रदोषो रजनीमुखम् <ls>Ak.</ls>; ‘प्रदोषेऽध्ययनं धीमान्न करोति यथाक्रमम्’ <ls>Śabda Ch.</ls>; तमःस्वभावास्तेऽप्यन्ये प्रदोषमनुयायिनः <ls>Śi. 2. 98</ls> (where प्रदोष primarily means ‘corrupt’ or ‘bad’); व्रजसुन्दरीजनमनस्तोषप्रदोषः <ls>Gīt. 5</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 44</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 93</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 1. 12</ls>.
